security_checks.details: Scrubbed all API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, and connection strings from operational memory logs.
Verified regex sanitizer strips SSNs, emails, document payloads, and raw OCR buffers before indexing.
AES-256 GCM encryption enforced across all SQLite/PostgreSQL knowledge tables and JSON manifests.
Restricted knowledge write & policy modification endpoints to verified Platform Reliability SRE roles.
All learning mutations signed with SHA-256 hashes and timestamped in append-only audit ledger.
